other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Mentions OMV Petrom (an oil & gas / petroleum company) as an example of an enterprise that certified its energy management system, citing energy-supply security benefits
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
At OMV Petrom, for example, the main benefits of achieving 
certification of their energy management system include: enhanced security of energy 
supply, commenced processes to reduce energy risk exposure in different areas,

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Bibliographic reference to ISO 50001 implementation guidelines for the oil and gas industry
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
OGP/IPIECA (2013), “Guidelines for implementing ISO 50001 Energy Management 
Systems in the oil and gas industry”, OGP Report Number 482

one_line: Management paper on designing ISO 50001 energy management systems, illustrated via case studies of enterprises in natural stone production, retail clothing, building design/consultancy, electricity/gas supply, and food retail; an oil & gas firm is mentioned only.
